basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old tech enthusiast from Austin, Texas, currently working as a junior software developer. I spend most of my evenings exploring new ideas and engaging in online discussions. I'm single and enjoy the freedom of being able to follow my interests wherever they may lead. I typically browse Reddit during my lunch breaks and late at night. My main interests include technology, libertarian philosophy, and humorous content. I dislike overly rigid structures and censorship, which is why I often gravitate towards subreddits that offer open discussions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in computer science, and my knowledge mainly stems from my formal education and self-learning through online resources. I am particularly interested in programming languages and the impact of technology on society.
